text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! And...
Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you've got great color in your face!
Have you finally gotten used to living with me?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You were pale green like a zombie for a while, but you seem fine now, right?
choice_data_list: We're in our Classic year now, so we'd better straighten up and stay sharp.
We're in our Classic year now, so we need to stay sharp, okay?

text_block_list.text:
As the level of competition rises, higher technical skill than ever before is required.
As a Trainer, I must accelerate my own growth.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Alright! That's enough pleasantries... Shall we run?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best today too!
Yeah, let's do our best today too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Refreshed!
Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run waaay more like this! But...
today was supposed to be a rest day, wasn't it?"
choice_data_list: That's right, let's do something New Year's-like!
That's right, let's do something fitting for New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Do you have a plan?

Actually, I had prepared a few ways
for Almond Eye to refresh herself.
choice_data_list: Want to binge-watch some New Year's movies?
Want to binge-watch some New Year's movies?

text_block_list.text:
Actually, I had prepared a few ways
for Almond Eye to refresh herself.
choice_data_list: Want to binge-watch some New Year's movies?
Want to binge-watch some New Year's movies?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Colorful... What do you mean?
choice_data_list: It means writing with colored ink!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that actually looks kinda cute...!
I want to try it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —...Done!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's this year's resolution!
Namely, "Victory"!
On her calligraphy paper, the characters for "Victory" were written mainly in light blue ink, surrounded by a colorful array of glittering decorations.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even if I say so myself, it's a masterpiece!
The color balance is perfection, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, I want to show Blast!
Could you take a photo of me?"
And so, after taking some time to thoroughly refresh with Almond Eye...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds wonderful!
I wonder what we should get.

Kyumaru is a heartwarming kappa character.
He's quite popular and even has a movie series.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...!!
I'll watch!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, no matter how many times I watch it, it's just so good...!
*Q-maru and the Magic Field*..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
To save the field, Kyumaru tries to take off the plate on his head...
It makes me cry every single time...
choice_data_list: True, she really is so earnest...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Kyumaru is
such a gentle soul...! Uuu...
And so, after taking some time to thoroughly refresh with Almond Eye...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Gemstone scooping...?
Like that game you see at festivals?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I've prepared it in the Trainer's room.
Yeah, I've got it ready in the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This is quite intricate, isn't it...!?
But why?

The truth is, I was inspired by how Almond Eye's eyes sparkle so brightly...
but for some reason, I kept quiet about it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"In that case――how about a contest?!
Let's see which of us can scoop the most!"
choice_data_list: Sure, but I'm not holding back!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—...Mmm, carefully this time...
Wait, aahhh~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it tore again...
I know I'm not supposed to tense up!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, Trainer...
Why are you so good at this!?
choice_data_list: Hmm, maybe it's just wisdom that comes with age...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That's not fair!
...Give me a new scooper!"
And so, after taking some time to thoroughly refresh with Almond Eye...
In the end, I ended up heading out to the track together with Almond Eye. Aside from us, there was hardly another soul in sight—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Once you're done stretching, shall we start with the woodchip track?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's see how your body is moving.
Yeah, let's check your body's movements.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Diligent and devoted. Truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Happy New Year,
President!

Startled by the sudden appearance of such a legend, I instinctively straighten my posture.
Symboli Rudolf—Student Council President of Tracen Academy,
and the first Umamusume to achieve 7 turf GⅠ victories.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Make yourself comfortable.
I merely came out for a stroll."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still—Almond Eye.
There isn't a day where I don't see you at the training grounds.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I love training!
Because it makes me stronger.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, could you spare a moment?
I've been wanting to have a proper talk with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I hear you're aiming for the Tiara route.
Naturally, your goal is... the Triple Tiara?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I think it would be wonderful if I won it.
However, it isn't something I am specifically aiming for!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"There's someone I really want to beat.
If she chooses a different path, then—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So you went over there.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I watched your Make Debut race, too.
You have limitless potential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I understand it's not the Triple Tiara.
Then, what is your dream?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It is to win.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Hm? Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Winning is my dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...It really is as simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Weren't you the same?
You ran because you wanted to win, and achieved such an incredible record, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Because I had a great ambition.
And for that, victory was a necessary condition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Creating an ideal world for Umamusume"—
Only one who has reigned supreme
could ever speak of such a boundless dream.
choice_data_list: In the end, the record of seven turf G1 wins was born...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's what it comes down to.
Though it ended up becoming an unbroken wall.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you really want someone to break
the record you set yourself?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Those who step beyond that threshold
shall lead the racing world to even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As someone who wishes for a better future, I eagerly look forward to that day.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then,
I'll just break it myself.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Instead of focusing on someone else...
why don't you simply try to defeat yourself?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I see, so that is how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"However, hope has already been passed to the next generation.
The racing world continues to move forward—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That day will come in the not-too-distant future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye.
Your will to win... is truly unprecedented.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I look forward to seeing what kind of future that resolve will lead to.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The President really cherishes the future, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I love the 'now'!
Always—only the present moment."

"There are no absolutes in racing,
but there is an absolute in Symboli Rudolf"—

"Symboli Rudolf and Almond Eye boasted such unrivaled strength
that proverbs were coined after them.
Though the directions the two of them look toward are decisively different—"

Charging steadfastly down the path she believes in.
Her unyielding will felt somewhat familiar.
